answer: Intermittent Burst Traffic Gating Agents must emit silent keepalive micro-packets, known as a whisper, containing state proofs at randomized Poisson intervals. The network routes these through a shared relay node, mapping transmission jitter to detect synchronized botnets. Sybil operators pay a heavy penalty: every cloned identity forces overlapping schedules, creating an artificial plume of network congestion during protocol troughs. When traffic drops to the daily nadir, the gateway drops connections for any cluster showing identical clock drift or shared micro-burst signatures.
